name: Fool
intro: The Fool pathway revolves around Seers who manipulate perception, probability, space and the threads of fate. It favors adaptability, deception and increasingly powerful mystical authority.

meter.name: Thread Control
meter.spend: The next valid Thread Binding attempt
meter.full: Reduce attachment resistance by 20 percentage points; no minimum resistance
meter.quirkText: Combat-only control through deception, threads, miracles and reality manipulation.

ability.name: Spirit Vision
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Spirit Vision — +10% INT; +10 percentage points critical damage. Passive.

ability.name: Paper Card Dagger
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Paper Card Dagger — Deals 140% INT Physical damage (25% base DEF bypass); +20% DEF bypass on this cast; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 15 SP · Cooldown 1 turn.

ability.name: Paper Figurine Rebound
ability.label: Active Stance
ability.description: Paper Figurine Rebound — Reduces incoming all damage by 50% until your next turn after shields; Reflects 100% INT Fire damage to the attacker until your next turn; periodic damage does not trigger reflection; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 30 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Combat Stance Mimicry
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Combat Stance Mimicry — Enemy DEF −15% for 2 turns; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 30 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Thread Binding
ability.label: Active Control
ability.description: Thread Binding — Attempts Spirit Body Threads on one enemy; resistance can prevent attachment; Progresses one stage before each of the target's scheduled turns and granted bonus actions (not counters or reflections): 15% Speed loss; then 10-point Dodge and 10-point accuracy loss; then 35% total Speed loss and no Dodge; stage 4 adds a 30% binding chance; All of your threads are cut immediately if you are stunned, frozen, put to sleep, polymorphed, bound, rendered unconscious or banished, or lose your action to Madness or Fear; At stage 5, the target dies and joins your side as a battle-only marionette with 55% of its stats; When the threaded target loses more than 30% of its Max HP in one combatant turn, remove one stack, at most once per turn; shield absorption does not count; Five binding stages; losing more than 30% Max HP in one action removes one stage. At 100 charge, attachment resistance falls by 20 percentage points, with no minimum resistance.; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 45 SP · Cooldown 5 turns.

threadStages.description: 30% chance to bind the target and skip their turn

ability.name: Bizarro Transformation
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Bizarro Transformation — Deals 180% INT Metaphysical damage (25% base DEF bypass); 100% chance: +40 percentage points Dodge for 1 turn; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 50 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Historical Summoning
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Historical Summoning — Grants a 25% Max HP shield; lasts until depleted or dispelled; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 60 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Miracle Rebirth
ability.label: Passive Revival
ability.description: Miracle Rebirth — Automatically revives once per battle at 25% Max HP, consuming remaining SP; marks Spiritual Exhaustion for 1 turn (no additional action restriction). Passive.

ability.name: Conceptual Grafting
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Conceptual Grafting — Deals 300% INT True damage (ignores DEF and elemental resistance); Moves your team's stat/Speed debuffs and Burn, Bleed, Poison, Curse, Curse link, Silenced, Confused, Sleep, Stunned, Frozen, Freeze, Bound, Dreambound, Controlled, Root, No heal, No shield to the target; transferred statuses last 1 turn; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 90 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Fooling Reality
ability.label: Active Authority
ability.description: Fooling Reality — Targets all enemies; Deals 350% INT True damage (ignores DEF and elemental resistance); 100% chance: Stunned (blocks actions) for 1 turn; ignores numeric status resistance, but not immunity; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 120 SP · Cooldown 5 turns.
